title: CSI SM — Set Mode
summary: CSI Ps h sets terminal modes: Ps=4 (IRM, insert/replace mode), Ps=20 (LNM, line feed/new line mode).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: the CSI sequence ends at its final byte.

params.name: IRM (Insert/Replace Mode)
params.meaning: CSI 4 h enables insert mode (characters inserted, not overwritten).

params.name: LNM (Line Feed/New Line Mode)
params.meaning: CSI 20 h enables LNM (LF also does CR).

gotchas: IRM: when enabled, characters are inserted (pushing existing text right); when disabled, characters overwrite.
LNM: when enabled, LF also performs CR (newline); when disabled, LF only moves down.
SM/DECSET both use 'h'; DEC private modes use '?h'.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: CSI sequence renders as a byte-exact sequence with final byte 'h'.
